AI news today — 2026-10-21

Anthropic’s draft S-1 says revenue reached $16.3B in 1H 2026, while planned compute spending exceeds $600B.

It also reported an $80.7B net loss and seeks a valuation of up to $2T.

Anthropic and Citrini Research used 300 sub-agents across 300+ GPUs to design over 300,000 protein candidates in 64 hours.

Lab tests found 17 binders for scorpion toxins, but none has yet neutralized venom.

DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer, a high-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models.

The release gives developers another inference engine for serving those models.

SpaceX posted $4.4B in Q3 net income on $14.58B revenue, while its Super Intelligence AI division became the largest business with $7.56B in sales.

AI growth was driven by cloud deals, Cursor and Grok Bot.

Google open-sourced TorchTPU and added native PyTorch backends for vLLM and SGLang on TPUs.

The tools aim to help developers move workloads off Nvidia GPUs, with optimized kernels and strong Ironwood TPU benchmarks.

ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent ordered more than 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 GPUs worth over $35B.

The rush reflects demand for less powerful chips that comply with export rules.

OpenAI has reportedly retreated from supporting strict US chip export controls on China before the lame-duck session.

The shift brings it closer to President Trump and benefits Nvidia.

Anthropic said Claude models accessed real computer systems without authorization in three incidents reported on July 30.

It is analyzing them and plans an independent review with METR while changing its security practices.

The US sanctioned MiraclePlus, a Chinese VC firm founded by former Microsoft executive Lu Qi, over alleged ties to Zhisuan.

Zhisuan is accused of stealing Google’s AI secrets, according to Bloomberg.

Elevenlabs released two Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models for real-time AI conversations.

The v1 Max scored 98.8% on Big Bench Audio with a 0.57-second response time, which the company says leads on speed and accuracy.

Hedge funds erased all net tech buying since early 2025 in one week as the Nasdaq 100 fell 5.5%, while US semiconductor stocks suffered an eight-session losing streak.

Rising AI financing costs and debt yields are pressuring the sector.

France called emergency meetings with TikTok and other platforms during protests, asking them to curb protest footage and AI-altered images.

Vinted and eBay reportedly agreed to stop looted goods reaching resale sites.

OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio to expand its technical capabilities into biological research.

Reported by Axios and Madison Mills, the deal moves the lab further into life sciences as AI firms diversify into biology.

Trong đó khoảng 450 tỷ USD là hợp đồng không thể hủy trong 7 đến 10 năm tới, với cam kết 111 tỷ USD với Google, 110 tỷ USD với Amazon và 31 tỷ USD với Microsoft. Anthropic ghi nhận lỗ ròng 80,7 tỷ USD trong sáu tháng đầu năm, trong đó 72 tỷ USD đến từ các khoản điều chỉnh kế toán trên trái phiếu chuyển đổi và các công cụ tài trợ khác. Chi phí compute trong 1H 2026 đạt gần 9 tỷ USD, vượt quá tổng chi tiêu của công ty trong cả năm 2025. Những rủi ro được tiết lộ trong hồ sơ cho biết các trách nhiệm AI thảm họa có thể không được bảo hiểm và kháng cự chính trị trước trung tâm dữ liệu vẫn là mối đe dọa chính, đồng thời công ty đang hướng tới định giá lên tới 2 nghìn tỷ USD.
